ModMetaData.name: Mass Consume
ModMetaData.author: Riketta
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a single Consume command for drafted pawns that works on the whole selection at once. The button shows how many of the selected pawns actually carry something consumable - "Consume (6/7)" means six of the seven selected pawns have an edible or drinkable item in their pockets. Pressing it drops a list of everything carried, one entry per item with its own carrier count ("Simple meal (6/7)"); picking an entry makes every selected pawn that carries it consume one right away, while pawns without the item do nothing.
Everything consumable counts: meals, raw food, drugs, beer, anything any mod or DLC makes ingestible. The decision is delegated to the game's own edibility checks - the exact same ones behind the consume button in a pawn's Inventory tab - so food restrictions, drug policies, traits and modded items all behave correctly with zero hardcoded defs. Orders go through the game's normal ordered-job pipeline: hold Shift while picking list entries to queue them up (eat the meal, then drink the beer, then take the go-juice) and the pawns work through the queue in order.
Optional layered debug logging (Off / Basic / Verbose) and a one-click selection overview live in the mod settings.
Source code & details: https://github.com/Riketta/MassConsume
